sources.note: the person's own home daily values: median +- k x max(1.4826 MAD, min_spread) over the window minus the recent days; Shewhart k = 3 (Montgomery); robust scale (Rousseeuw and Croux 1993)
min_spread is a floor for near-identical readings (device resolution plus margin), an owner parameter, not a clinical threshold (design D2)

note: health profile iteration 1 (docs/design/health-profile.md 3.2): flags when persistence of the last recent_days daily values lie outside the band on the same side; emits nothing below min_baseline_days; weekly roll-up only
